name: grepo-chrome-extension
description: Local 32-shard GitHub starred/forked repository search & knowledge cockpit (Chrome MV3 extension)

scripts.check:syntax: node --check extension/background/service-worker.js && node --check extension/pages/dashboard/app.js && node --check extension/pages/sidepanel/sidepanel.js
scripts.check:manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8')),paths=[m.background.service_worker,m.side_panel.default_path,...Object.values(m.icons),...Object.values(m.action.default_icon)];for(const p of paths){if(!fs.existsSync(path.join('extension',p)))throw new Error('Missing manifest asset: '+p);}console.log('✓ Manifest v'+m.version+' valid ('+paths.length+' entry assets verified)');"
scripts.validate: npm run check:manifest && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:ids && npm run check:themes
scripts.test:ux: node tests/check-p0-ux.mjs && node tests/check-detail.mjs && node tests/check-tag-dialog.mjs && node tests/check-theme.mjs && node tests/check-readme-render.mjs
